reviews.title: Horrible app!
reviews.text:
I have had so many problems with this app application! It’s never working and it is a hassle to get it to work. I have so many issues with it that I can’t even place my orders on this app, it won’t let me do anything. Customer service please do something about this problem as soon as possible because I am getting tired and frustrated of not being able to use it because it’s always giving me an error message every time I try to sign in and it keeps saying to try again later but I have been trying to get in the the app for 7
Days without any luck. Please fix this issue as soon as possible before you  lose any more customers!

reviews.title: Super slow and unresponsive
reviews.text: Ever since the update, it’s been buggy and slow. Search results disappear and simple actions like removing an item from cart take forever.

reviews.title: Worst update ever
reviews.text: Cannot log in on either iPad or iPhone. Blank screen when you click on Sign In. Stop doing stupid things trying to make the app batter. You make it worse every time you do.

reviews.title: Customer service
reviews.text: Slow to respond

reviews.title: Awful.
reviews.text: Constant bugs on mobile, freezes, things won’t load etc. Even worse on iPad, I can’t even sign in, keep getting entirely blank screens

reviews.title: Forced to sign in over and over again
reviews.text: Not sure if they’ve done something recently to the app, because I don’t remember having issues with it before, but I just abandoned an order because of how glitchy and unusable the app was. It prompted me to sign in over and over again, despite checking off the option to keep me signed in. It showed my cart as empty on one tab, but full of items on another. Despite being signed in to my account on one tab, it prompted me to sign in to my account again to check out, and then wouldn’t let me complete sign in. I tried to check out as a guest instead, but that glitched out too.

reviews.title: Rewards disappear
reviews.text: I have yet to get a reward voucher on my app to where I can use it, despite it tracking all my purchases. I’m $23 to the gold tier which is $300 spent in one year, but they haven’t given me a single reward voucher to use. I know they’re selling our data like every other company, why is it so hard to give customers the bare minimum which they earned by shopping at their store?

reviews.title: fix
reviews.text: i should not have to login when I’m already logged in on the app. specifically when i go to my order. I literally login to go to my order to where it makes me login again.

reviews.title: Coupon
reviews.text: Credit card holder coupon is not available the app. I have made multiple purchases before I found it on the website. I am considering closing my credit card due to this. It no longer benefits me. My store barely has the signal to work the app the website is not an option

reviews.title: Keeps crashing!
reviews.text: I'm trying to use the app but it keeps shutting down. I'll have to go to my computer to visit the store since the app is useless.

reviews.title: Coupons disappear once in store!
reviews.text: Why do the coupons disappear when you’re in the store?! Joann’s would never.

reviews.title: App keeps signing me out
reviews.text: The app is very slow. I only use it because it’s cheaper than purchasing the item on store. But I keep having to sign myself in. Every single time no matter what boxes I check. It’s frustrating

reviews.title: Awful
reviews.text: I have been a Michaels shopper for about two decades but this app is awful. It freezes, randomly shuts down, and takes forever for searches to load. It’s unusable most of the time so I use their website or even have to search competitors sites  instead. Please fix the app!

reviews.title: Not Worth The Time
reviews.text: This app has potential, but in its current iteration, it’s pretty much useless. The entries show the quantity of items in the store, but the store says: “we have not received that yet, check back in a week or so.” NOT ACCEPTABLE. I don’t have the time or the inclination to keep visiting the store *hoping* the desired items will be there. There needs to be an accuracy between the app, the inventory system and the local store—otherwise this feature results in unnecessary trips to see if the item has arrived.

reviews.title: Coexist?
reviews.text:
Proof that the “coexist” bumper sticker is a lie. If I brought in a painting of Obama and his wife Micheal, this lady would happily frame it with great love and care. The Trump painting wasn’t going to be used at a protest. Give me a break. What complete garbage of customer service. The hypocrisy of these people is disgusting. 

I’m done with Micheal’s and I’ve deleted the app. From now on I’ll have to drive 25 minutes to Hobby Lobby or purchase things I would have bought at Michael’s on Amazon. Sadly I have a Michael’s two minutes from my house. Oh well, I work retail and often recommend Michael’s to customers looking for certain items that we don’t carry. Not anymore! Micheal’s who? You’re cooked. Good day!

reviews.title: App is awful
reviews.text: I LOVE Michael’s.. the app, not so much. It’s incredibly buggy, slow and doesn’t work 90% of the time. Please upgrade your app!!!

reviews.title: Stop
reviews.text: Forcing me to update in the middle of checking out in store and not allowing me to use my coupons and vouchers is diabolical. Don’t do it. Quickest way for me to drop my stuff and leave without purchasing.

reviews.title: Frustrating glitches
reviews.text: As others have said this app will kick you out randomly when trying to browse for products also, it will show coupon codes that aren’t actually available until the next day.

reviews.title: Immediately crashes.
reviews.text: This app has always sucked, slow and buggy, none of the photos load unless you click on an item. Ever since I updated the app yesterday now it immediately crashes! The website is just as bad. Does Micheals even want us to shop with them?

So annoying the app ask for a security code every time, is so hard to find the statement, I pay on time and they charged me every month, the cards doesn’t work so I pay with another credit card, Michaels is charging me I don’t knot what because nothing appears in my orders History. 
So disappointed

reviews.title: Horrible App!
reviews.text: It is so glitchy and is constantly signing me out. I was just on it a little bit ago trying to place an order. I had to go and do something else and it signed me out. Now nothing I can do will allow it to let me back in. I guess they just lost out on some more sales. I can get the same thing for the same price without having to use a coupon on Amazon.

reviews.title: Dread using this app.
reviews.text: Hands down the worst app I’ve ever used. Constantly freezes or glitches. Makes trying to look, add or even cancel order incredibly hard by how much it just lags. But it sure does work great in taking your money! Seriously. Fix your app.

reviews.title: Won’t log in-continual error
reviews.text: Using Face ID doesn’t work. Using actual password doesn’t work. No clue how to get into the app now since it keeps timing out and not logging in. :/ guess any rewards I’ve got are forfeit now. Oh well.

reviews.title: Constantly freezes
reviews.text: The app constantly freezes and I have to close out and reopen. Their search function is faulty, and inconsistent. It will show products and then a second later show nothing and crash. Their filtering in the search function does not work at all. When I am scrolling and click on a product to view and then go back it automatically puts me back to the top, which is annoying. My local store has been having inventory issues for some time. I’ve also had to deal with one of their employees checking off that I picked up an in store pickup order when I hadn’t yet. I had to call corporate, email, and call the store multiple times to get it figured out. I asked for a refund and they said I had to go in person. It was a hassle. The online only discounts become frustrating when the inventory is incorrect and the in-store pick up option is slow and unreliable. Overall I think they could use a lot of improvement on their app, their inventory management, and their customer service.

reviews.title: Just let me log in….
reviews.text: Can’t even log into the app. Your Sign In button doesn’t work! And you make me enter the verification code twice and tell me it’s wrong! 🫩🫩🫩🫩 If you’re using AI to halfheartedly run security… it IS NOTNSECURE

It’s just stuck on the opening red title screen. I did all of the basic tech stuff to see if it really was just my device, but it still won’t load. Maybe an update is needed, Michaels. Please look into that.

She said I had to read on the app the returned policy when I went to return them and was denied. I guess Amazon is getting another customer with easier returns on craft merchandise. Wanted to support the local stores, but this is become too much.

reviews.title: How is a major chain store’s app so bad?
reviews.text: Literally it crashes all of the time. Now I can’t log in bc when I do it just sits there & spins. It’s up to date (I checked) it’s just a crummy app. I’d legit spend more money if your app made it easier to shop

reviews.title: Crashes constantly
reviews.text: When the app works, I can find whatever I need pretty easily. But the app does not seem to be able to handle loading more than a few listings to a page.

reviews.title: Changing a Password
reviews.text:
This has to be the worst process I’ve ever been through in my entire life. An event that took me less than 3-5 minutes on every other app I’ve been on today has so far taken me 45 minutes on Michaels. And I’m not even done. I had to take a break out of frustration. 
Are you kidding me with this?
I’ve deleted and reinstalled the app. I don’t have multiple accounts. I have one. I only want to change my email address. Simple. I can sign in on the website, just not the app. 
I guess I don’t need it.

reviews.title: Fix your promos to work
reviews.text:
The app could be useful if the promos actually applied correctly. No point in coupons if they don’t work, or apply to virtually no items in the store. Or if the chat remembered your session so that if you have to switch apps for 2 seconds and you get kicked, you don’t lose your chat.

Suffice it to say my last session, which should have ended in me placing a decent sized order, ended with me not being able to order anything.

reviews.title: Reduced functionality
reviews.text: Both the app and the website no longer tell you where to locate in-stock items in the store. A 1 star rating might seem overly harsh for this, but those were useful features that were removed, actively making the shopping experience worse.

Lord bless you guys for the hard work you put into it.

reviews.title: No aisle location anymore?

The AI model is even worse- it gave me an aisle for the product… on the other side of the store. How very disappointing.

reviews.title: Only (partly) useful outside the store
reviews.text: I’ve tried everything and can’t seem to make this app work inside an actual store. I have to take screenshots of coupons or item locations before I go in. And heaven forbid I want to check the price of an item I find while wandering the aisles. And searching for something outside of the store often gives you hundreds of results that aren’t even sold by Michael’s, so no coupon can even be used on them.

reviews.title: Never works

reviews.title: Terribly slow and glitchy

I need to give it at least 5 minutes to load my rewards and coupons before approaching the cash register. I love Michael’s, but there have been multiple occasions where I shop online at a different store instead of dealing with this app.

reviews.title: Why is this app so difficult?
reviews.text: I love shopping at Michael’s…I wish the app wasn’t so difficult. I guess it’s a good thing for me that the app is horrible because it saves me from spending a lot of money…however, it would still be nice to be able to shop the app without it freezing every couple of seconds. It’s genuinely the worst app I have on my phone. For such a large chain, you would think they could create an app that actually works. I wanted to buy a bunch of stuff this morning for an event I’m participating in, but, I guess I’ll be shopping on Amazon instead because the Michael’s app just keeps freezing and it’s impossible to buy anything. What a shame…

reviews.title: Buggy app
reviews.text: This app is terrible. It’s so slow, buggy, and constantly closes. Trying to place an order is the biggest nightmare in the world

reviews.title: It used to be useful!
reviews.text:
Until recently, the app was my go-to for craft supplies! I could buy online to pick up in store, I could research what I wanted to buy ahead of time, and I could access my coupons quickly.

One of the recent updates (possibly when the digital assistant was added) slowed the app down to the point where it’s not worth using. Upon opening, my phone immediately gets hot and stays that way until I *force close* the app. I’m lucky if I can do a search AND open one of the results in the first session- often I have to force quit at least twice before it works. 

Finally, the app no longer lets my payments go through (even though the website does). It’s the same payment method both times, but the app cites an error and stalls every time.

PLEASE simplify your app again so I can continue ordering from you!

reviews.title: Reviewing the app, not the store
reviews.text: The store is great. The app is so, so slow and clunky. It freezes all the time. I can barely search for anything. It is great to have the functionality of seeing what is in stock in stores near me, but it never responds in the app. It takes so long to pull up a search, and the chances of it crashing as you begin to look through the results is so high.

reviews.title: Cannot handle large orders
reviews.text:
Unfortunately the app is not able to handle large orders. Trying to order a bunch of beads and components causes the app to freeze up and crash. If it does work, it’s extremely slow to move between screens. And forget actually reviewing your cart.

App becomes unusable and the only option is to either continue on a browser or clearing out the cart by ordering or removing everything, the app suddenly works again once the cart is empty. 

I have left the app to go to other sites to order on multiple occasions.

reviews.title: Not good. MOVE “ASK MIKE”!!
reviews.text: For the love of all things crafty, please move the “Ask Mike” button! I cannot scroll on this app without clicking it. I am right handed and the only way I can maneuver through this app is with my left hand, which is extremely annoying. It also stops responding randomly. It takes me a a while to pick out yarn and I have had to close out and reopen the app three times in one sitting. I updated the app and it just did it again! It’s truly and awful app. Between the Ask Mike button and the Affirm button, I am constantly clicking on these and opening a new window. Please fix this.

I love to shop at Michaels and love the pick up options just the app is very buggy if you are buying multiple things  it freezes or reset the search completely after a while 
It a but frustrating when looking for fabric and every two pages it reset to the beginning

Michaels needs to figure it out. they took over Joann’s and now they charge me $28 for shipping to Alaska no matter how much i purchase. after living here, i can assure you it is not $28 for shipping. and their dumb app doesn’t even work. even moved all my prior orders into my cart so i had to spend 20 minutes and my phone over heating removing 48 items from my cart in this glitchy app

reviews.title: app is poo
reviews.text: genuinely the worst shopping app i’ve used. don’t get me wrong, michael’s is a great craft store w a lot of great products and discounts, but this review is only for the app. the whole thing loads SO SLOW and every time i need to refresh it (as in swipe out and go back into the app). i just placed an order and had to refresh the app 12 times. changing your pick up location is also hard. i tried changing my pick up in store location and maybe i’m doing it wrong/inefficiently but i had to change the location for EVERY PRODUCT, which is not bad since i only had three BUT STILL imagine if i had a lot. at the end of the day please update the app lol, but michael’s itself is great!

reviews.title: App Crashes Constantly

reviews.title: Laggiest App Award
reviews.text: Truly the most frustrating, laggy, slow, awful app on my phone. Literally can’t swipe to any other screen or the whole thing freezes for half a minute. Its awful

reviews.title: Poor quality
reviews.text: So I’ve notice is quite often now and I’m not sure why Michael’s is doing this to their customers, but they will tell you that they have something in a certain location, you will add it to your cart thinking that that’s where it’s going to be picked up at since that is where it’s telling you it’s being ordered from, then you get to your car and it has being picked up from a location that is not the location. It says it was going to be picked. And it is in no way close. I had selected to pick up an item from my local store and wanted it added to the cart it had me picking it up four states away in another store. I don’t know where this company gets their algorithm from that does that but it’s misleading. It’s customers. I’ve actually decided to go spend more money somewhere else to buy the same things because of this.

reviews.title: Utterly useless since the recent upgrades
reviews.text: Whatever “upgrades” that have been done recently, it has rendered the app completely useless on my phone. I have not been able to login to open the app for a few weeks now. Even after completely deleting and reinstalling it simply will not work. I cannot log in, I can’t even do search for a store. A month ago it was working perfectly. I could access my account, coupons and rewards, and shop, but since then there have been two updates and I have not been able to open the app at all. This is very frustrating particularly when trying to shop. I have contacted customer service twice and all they do is give me a temporary password that also does not work. I’m about ready give up shopping there and find my supplies elsewhere, even if it means I pay more. The aggravation is not worth it.
